source_policy: Existing Philco and manufacturer evidence remains unchanged. These are explicit game presentation choices under the approved behavioral scope, not new physical wiring claims.

avc_variant.decision: Use the schematic-side 0.05 uF reference as the named game variant. The parts-list 0.1 uF remains an acknowledged alternative. The game's AVC timing is a declared service approximation, not a fitted capacitor equation.

diodes.socket_mapping: Unassigned in the game functional diagram; manufacturer pins 5 and 6 remain distinct historical electrodes. No glyph-to-pin assignment is invented.

oscillator.label: Oscillator feedback / tuning assembly
oscillator.representation: Functional block. The four-dot coupling symbol remains in the historical source; it is not presented as a resolved physical winding circuit.

field_coil.presentation: Wound field assembly with 500 ohm service resistance. Legacy SKU retained for saved games; this is not an interchangeable carbon resistor. 3D service placement is illustrative.

component_classes.R: Measured resistance, grid/cathode/plate role and I-squared-R rating. R1 is a keyed field assembly. Missing/open changes its stage or creates floating-grid hum/bias.
component_classes.C: Capacitance, leakage under test voltage and voltage rating affect coupling, filtering or oscillator operation; open parts read zero capacitance.
component_classes.TUBE: Correct type required. Emission, series heater, leakage/gas and dissipation govern stage behavior. Test only when pulled.
component_classes.OT: Matching output assembly; winding continuity, resistance and current stress. Open or missing loses plate supply/output.
component_classes.IFT: 455 kHz assembly, winding continuity and manual IF centers. Open or missing interrupts IF; no alternative winding SKU is sold.
component_classes.COIL: Matching oscillator assembly; open or missing stops conversion. No alternative coil SKU is sold.
component_classes.VR: 500 kilohm control; volume, open track and scratch. No alternative taper/value SKU is sold.
component_classes.SPK: Matching speaker voice-coil assembly; open coil or cone rub. No alternative impedance SKU is sold.

access: The Inspector service-part selector exposes every supported repair location independently of the camera. Top/underside locations are functional service locations, not a factory lead-dress certification. Loop and alignment actions are in Generator / alignment.
